other_conditions: The affected family must be a local resident of Madhya Pradesh.
The family must not be eligible for the Chief Minister Covid-19 Yodha Kalyan Yojana.
The deceased parents should not have been government servants or employees of a government undertaking eligible for the old pension scheme.
One parent must have died from COVID‑19 (or a parent died earlier and the legal guardian died from COVID‑19).
Eligibility is limited to the period from 01 March 2021 to 30 June 2021.
benefits_summary: Provides a monthly pension of ₹5,000 plus free ration, and covers education fees from school through higher, technical, and medical courses.
